text: To swim, you need to begin by breathing. This means that your lungs must be prepared to take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide. Once your lungs are sufficiently warmed up, you can start to kick your legs in the water. Kicking helps you move through the water more efficiently and enables you to propel yourself forward. Be sure to keep your head above water and your eyes focused on the water so you can see where you're going and avoid obstacles.
